text: Assumption: ETH_RECEIVED_MORE_DATA_AVAILABLE signals the caller to immediately call Eth_Receive() again — is this correct?

norm: eth_received_more_data_available signals the caller to immediately call eth_receive again
assumption: ETH_RECEIVED_MORE_DATA_AVAILABLE signals the caller to immediately call Eth_Receive() again.
rationale: The payload documents the presence of further frames, but does not specify the control structure of the upper receive routine.
